title: Module.register is deprecated
summary: Node.js deprecates module.register (DEP0205: documentation-only since v25.9.0, runtime deprecation since v26.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of module.register with module.registerHooks().

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
